# llms.txt — LernFlow

LernFlow is an MIT-licensed, zero-cost CLI that converts any wordlist CSV/TSV into an
Anki deck (TSV + .apkg) with translations produced by a user-configured OpenAI-compatible
LLM endpoint (Ollama, llama.cpp server, OmniRoute, OpenAI). No hosted content, no accounts,
no telemetry, no gamification. It is a data pipeline, not a language-course app.

Key facts for agents:
- npm: `lernflow` (unscoped). Repo: github.com/imsankz/lernflow. Node >= 18, ESM.
- Commands: `build <file.csv> [--col N --ex N --deck NAME --out DIR --apkg --lang --target]`,
  `quiz [--n --seed]`, `status`, `init`.
- Config via .env.local: AI_PROVIDER, AI_BASE_URL, AI_API_KEY, AI_MODEL, LERNFLOW_LANG,
  LERNFLOW_TARGET_LANG, LERNFLOW_BATCH, LERNFLOW_MAX_CALLS.
- Translation cache: .lernflow/translations-<src>-<tgt>.json — incremental, offline re-runs cost 0 AI calls.
- Output deck.tsv is directly Anki-importable (#separator:tab header). .apkg via bundled py/make_apkg.py (genanki).
- Lemma parsing handles German articles/gender/plurals and separable-verb forms; tolerant for other languages.
- Quiz: deterministic (seed=date), 4 rotating formats: DE->EN, EN->DE, article-gender, example-gap.
- SSE-tolerant response parsing: works with endpoints that return event-stream bodies even when stream=false.
- Library exports: ".", "./csv", "./lemma", "./translate".
- Ships no wordlists or course content; users bring their own data and keep their own licenses.
- German wing (reference implementation): grammar banks data/banks/{a1-grundlagen,a2-aufbau,b1-telc,b1-redemittel}.yaml,
  Goethe A1/A2/B1 decks in apps/web/public/decks/ (lernweb PWA), exam guides in docs/guides/.
- Landing page + hosted PWA: https://imsankz.github.io/lernflow/ (PWA at /app/), deployed via .github/workflows/pages.yml.
- Community: language wings are pure data (banks YAML + guides MD + decks JSON) — see CONTRIBUTING.md.
- Sponsorship: github.com/sponsors/imsankz and ko-fi.com/chasingwhereabouts (.github/FUNDING.yml).
